checks.name: AIM-006
checks.conditionText: Every custom panel validated against: schema, runtime compatibility, UI boundary
checks.expectation: Every custom panel validated against: schema, runtime compatibility, UI boundary
checks.summary: Custom panel validation tooling exists and shows schema/runtime/boundary signals.

hits.line: $checks += New-AiCheck "PAN04" "Panel arrays exist" (((Get-AiProperty $Panel "dataSources" $null) -is [array]) -and ((Get-AiProperty $Panel "visibleFields" $null) -is [array]) -and ((Get-AiProperty $Panel "actions" $null) -is [array])) "dataSources/visibleFields/actions must be arrays." "FAIL_PANEL_CONTRACT"

$checks += New-AiCheck "PAN16" "Trusted source panel is explicit" ($implementationMode -eq "trustedSource" -and $implementationLanguage -in @("html+javascript", "html", "javascript") -and -not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($implementationEntrypoint)) ("mode=" + $implementationMode + "; language=" + $implementationLanguage + "; entrypoint=" + $implementationEntrypoint) "FAIL_PANEL_CONTRACT"
$checks += New-AiCheck "PAN13" "Panel visible fields resolve to model fields" ($unknownVisibleFields.Count -eq 0) ("unknownVisibleFields=" + ($unknownVisibleFields -join ",")) "FAIL_PANEL_BINDING"

$checks += New-AiCheck "PAN15" "Expected panel behavior binds panel id" ($expectedPanelId -eq $actualPanelId) ("expectedPanelId=" + $expectedPanelId + "; actualPanelId=" + $actualPanelId) "FAIL_PANEL_CONTRACT"
Write-NPDevOk ("AI custom procedure-panel integration passed for " + $pipeline.result.scenarioId)
Write-NPDevWarn ("AI custom procedure-panel integration failed as " + $pipeline.result.resultClass)
Write-NPDevOk ("AI custom panel scenario passed for " + $pipeline.result.scenarioId)
Write-NPDevWarn ("AI custom panel scenario failed as " + $pipeline.result.resultClass)
Write-NPDevOk "AI custom panel runtime verification passed."
Write-NPDevWarn "AI custom panel runtime verification failed."
throw "AI custom panel runtime verification failed."

checks.name: AIM-007
checks.conditionText: Every custom procedure validated against: schema, capability requirements, execution limits
checks.expectation: Every custom procedure validated against: schema, capability requirements, execution limits
checks.summary: Custom procedure validation tooling exists and shows schema/capability/execution-limit signals.

hits.line: $checks += New-AiCheck "PROC05" "Inputs and outputs are arrays" (((Get-AiProperty $Procedure "inputs" $null) -is [array]) -and ((Get-AiProperty $Procedure "outputs" $null) -is [array])) "inputs/outputs must be arrays." "FAIL_PROCEDURE_CONTRACT"

$checks += New-AiCheck "PROC06" "Procedure has steps or trusted source" (($steps.Count -gt 0) -or $hasTrustedSource) ("stepCount=" + $steps.Count + "; implementationMode=" + $implementationMode) "FAIL_PROCEDURE_CONTRACT"

$checks += New-AiCheck "PROC11" "Trusted Java source procedure is explicit" ($hasTrustedSource -and $trust -eq "trusted" -and $implementationLanguage -eq "java" -and -not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($implementationEntrypoint) -and -not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($implementationClassName)) ("mode=" + $implementationMode + "; language=" + $implementationLanguage + "; entrypoint=" + $implementationEntrypoint + "; className=" + $implementationClassName) "FAIL_PROCEDURE_ADMISSION"

$checks += New-AiCheck "PROC10" "Expected procedure behavior binds procedure id" ($expectedProcedureId -eq $actualProcedureId) ("expectedProcedureId=" + $expectedProcedureId + "; actualProcedureId=" + $actualProcedureId) "FAIL_PROCEDURE_CONTRACT"
throw ("Trusted procedure language is not supported by the beta harness: " + $language)
throw "Trusted procedure source returned no JSON output."
Write-NPDevOk ("AI custom procedure-panel integration passed for " + $pipeline.result.scenarioId)
Write-NPDevWarn ("AI custom procedure-panel integration failed as " + $pipeline.result.resultClass)
concepts = @([pscustomobject]@{ name = "TemplateItem"; fields = @([pscustomobject]@{ name = "id"; type = "uuid"; id = $true; required = $true }) })
Write-NPDevOk ("AI custom procedure scenario passed for " + $pipeline.result.scenarioId)
Write-NPDevWarn ("AI custom procedure scenario failed as " + $pipeline.result.resultClass)
throw ("Trusted Java procedure compilation failed: " + (($compileOutput | Out-String).Trim()))
throw ("Trusted Java procedure execution failed: " + (($runOutput | Out-String).Trim()))
